mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT a.`device_id` as `deviceId`,a.`device_name` as `deviceName`,a.`code` `code`, a.`device_prod_category_name` as `deviceProdCategoryName`, a.`area_name` as `area`, b.`gear_position_code` as `gearPositionCode`, c.`map_code` `mapCode`, a.`device_status` FROM `security_device` a LEFT JOIN `device_position` b ON a.`device_id` = b.`cold_water_device` LEFT JOIN `water_map_type` c ON a.`device_prod_category_code` = c.`device_prod_category_code` where a.`application_code` = 'COOLINGWATER'
and (a.`code` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%') or a.`device_name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%'))
and a.`area_id` like concat('%',#{param.areaIds},'%')
and a.`device_prod_category_code_concat` like concat('%',#{param.deviceType},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT d.`code` `deviceCode`, c.`code` `code`, c.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, c.`wholesaler_id` `wholesalerId`, c.`shift_master_phone` `shiftMasterPhone`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, b.`department` `department`, a.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, c.`update_by` `updateBy`, c.`create_time` `createTime`, c.`update_time` `updateTime` FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b ON a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` c ON b.`wholesaler` = c.`wholesaler_id` LEFT JOIN `security_device` d ON a.`cold_water_device` = d.`device_id` where 1=1
and b.`department_id` like concat('%',#{param.departmentId},'%')
and c.`shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')
and c.`code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and d.`code` like concat('%',#{param.deviceCode},'%')
and b.`gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and c.`update_by` like concat('%',#{param.operator},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT a.`cold_water_device` `deviceId`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, a.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode` FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b on a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` where a.`cold_water_device` in
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT d.`code` `deviceCode`, c.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, c.`wholesaler_id` `wholesalerId`, c.`shift_master_phone` `shiftMasterPhone`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea` FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b ON a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` c ON b.`wholesaler` = c.`wholesaler_id` LEFT JOIN `security_device` d ON a.`cold_water_device` = d.`device_id` where d.`device_id` = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT d.`code` `deviceCode`, c.`code` `code`, c.`shift_master` `shiftMaster`, c.`wholesaler_id` `wholesalerId`, c.`shift_master_phone` `shiftMasterPhone`, b.`gear_position_code` `gearPositionCode`, b.`gear_position_area` `gearPositionArea`, b.`department` `department`, a.`unit_traffic` `unitTraffic`, c.`update_by` `updateBy`, c.`create_time` `createTime`, c.`update_time` `updateTime` FROM `device_position` a LEFT JOIN `gear_position` b ON a.`gear_position_id` = b.`gear_position_id` LEFT JOIN `cold_wholesaler` c ON b.`wholesaler` = c.`wholesaler_id` LEFT JOIN `security_device` d ON a.`cold_water_device` = d.`device_id` where 1=1
and b.`department_id` like concat('%',#{param.departmentId},'%')
and c.`shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')
and c.`code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and d.`code` like concat('%',#{param.deviceCode},'%')
and b.`gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and c.`update_by` like concat('%',#{param.operator},'%')
